features.note: Generated signage reinforces the plan: red marquee + 'Cinemex' word sign, glass door bank, numbered auditorium door plates (5/6/7 legible in corridor and ug67 presets), green EXIT signs on both corridor walls, directional floor chevrons and carpet pattern down the spine, generic abstract poster blocks. No protected movie art anywhere; all poster/menu/screen art is flat geometric color-block composition.

Scored only on what this asset unit owns: the 4+4 room masses read clearly in complete-network, and door plates + evacuation markings differentiate the rooms at the spine. Acoustic-panel rhythm, aisle marks and screen content are auditorium-family fit-out (asset units 3-5) and are not penalized here; the sala-3 preset shows shell/circulation only, as expected at unit 01.

Concession menu boards carry generated headers that change deterministically between display_frame 0 ('BEBIDAS') and 1 ('POPCORN'), POS faces glow on their posts, kitchen shows stainless workline + hood + extract duct, facade poster bank sits fully in frame. Lobby preset is sparse (counter mass, tile floor, no kiosk/showtime surfaces yet) — that fit-out belongs to asset unit 02, so only the shell-level signage is scored.

The 14 TC300s now exist as real surface devices: dark rounded faces with a lit blue status dot, visible at close range (arch ug67 preset shows one mounted beside the sala door). Every RS-485 drop terminates ON a device face, not a bare junction cube (clearest in kitchen: drop ends on the TC300-05 face; sala-3: drops end on TC300-07/-08 faces). ID chips TC300-01..14 are readable, plus UC-A/B/C/D, BUS A-D and UG67 chips. The chain reads end-to-end without a shortcut edge: TC300 -> green RS-485 trunks -> UC100 -> blue dashed LoRaWAN -> UG67 (two vertical antennas, real device) -> continuous blue Ethernet -> ROUTER/FIREWALL -> INTERNET -> NIAGARA -> PC/TABLET/SMARTPHONE, every external block connected and captioned. The Ethernet run leaves the building unobstructed; the diagram board sits above/right and does not occlude it. The board itself is strong: title, the full chain as a subtitle, four bus boxes whose memberships sum to exactly 14 (A=5, B=4, C=4, D=1), green arrowed RS-485 edges, four labelled RF ports (RF1-RF4) on UG67-01, a full legend (RS-485 solid green / LoRaWAN dashed blue / Ethernet solid blue / alarm red / no-comms gray), all captions inside their boxes, and a cyan leader line tying the board to the REAL UG67 in the model rather than replacing it. Deductions: the RS-485 green is desaturated in-scene — it renders as pale mint/near-white with a heavy bloom halo in the ug67, kitchen, corridor and complete-network captures, so it is traceable but not read as 'green' at a glance; and at complete-network the LoRaWAN links degrade into chunky whitish cube chains rather than blue dashes, which adds clutter and weakens the blue-dashed vs blue-solid distinction at that distance (at close presets the dashes are correctly light blue and unambiguous). On the board, the dashed LoRaWAN edges and the Niagara->client fan-out edges carry no arrowheads, so 'explicit direction on every edge' is only partly met.

Architecture captures are fully clean of technical labels, network media and zone volumes — facade, lobby, concessions, kitchen, corridor, sala-3 and ug67 all show opaque massing plus only diegetic signage. Engineering adds the labels, legend board, green/blue media and translucent shell. Deduction: the engineering shell translucency stacks many transparent planes (ug67, kitchen, corridor) into a milky ghosting that dulls contrast around the labels and the RS-485 runs.

important_features.note: 1.8 m figure against 2.1 m doors reads correct; TC300/UC100/UG67 stay at real (tiny) size and are surfaced by label chips and presets rather than being inflated. UG67 antennas are correctly ~0.6 m and vertical.
Not owned by this pass. Emissive channels exist (marquee, menus, POS, exit signs, ceiling strips) but the hierarchy is unpolished; deliberately not penalized beyond neutral.

Trunks run at ceiling height along walls with junction corners, drops descend vertically and land on device faces; the kitchen hood/extract duct is contact-coherent. No floating tube segments observed. Slight ambiguity where the pale trunk crosses transparent walls in the ug67 preset.

defects: RS-485 media colour is washed out in-scene: in surface-attempt3-eng-ug67, -eng-kitchen, -eng-corridor and -eng-complete-network the trunks render as pale mint/near-white ribbons with a wide bloom halo instead of the saturated #29d67d green defined in the spec; on the diagram board the same media is correctly saturated green, so the scene and the legend disagree.

At complete-network the LoRaWAN links read as chains of chunky whitish cubes (packet/wave pool) rather than blue dashes; the RF colour identity is lost at that distance and the cube chains add visual clutter across the roofless plan.

On the diagram board, the four dashed LoRaWAN edges (UC100-A..D -> RF1..RF4) and the three Niagara -> PC/TABLET/SMARTPHONE edges carry no arrowheads, so direction is explicit only on the RS-485 and Ethernet edges.
Engineering shell transparency stacks into a milky ghosting in the ug67, kitchen and corridor captures; overlapping wall/door planes wash out contrast behind label chips and behind the RS-485 runs.

In surface-attempt3-eng-lobby the TC300-01 and TC300-14 drops terminate in a device that is only a few pixels tall and unlit at that framing — the ID chip carries the read, the device face and status ring do not.
surface-attempt3-eng-concessions shows no TC300-02 label chip at all (distance-culled) even though the concessions preset is a required surface view for that endpoint's zone.
The lobby architecture preset is nearly bare — floor, one counter mass, marquee soffit — so the 'surface' read there is carried almost entirely by the facade behind the camera.
corrections: Raise RS-485 saturation in-scene: drive the trunk/drop material toward the spec colour #29d67d with a lower emissive multiplier and a tighter bloom so the line reads as saturated green, not white glow, at the ug67/kitchen/corridor/complete-network presets. Match the board legend swatch exactly.
Recolour the LoRaWAN packet/wave pool instances to the network_blue #2d9cff family and shrink them, so at complete-network the UC100->UG67 links still read as blue dashed RF and never as white beads.
Add arrowheads to the four dashed LoRaWAN edges and the three Niagara->client edges on the diagram board so every edge in the canonical chain carries explicit direction.
Reduce engineering shell ghosting: enforce a single-layer translucent shell (or depth-sorted/back-face-culled walls) so overlapping planes do not accumulate opacity behind labels and network runs.

Give the TC300 face a slightly stronger status-ring emissive and a minimum on-screen size floor for the ring only (not the housing), so at the lobby/corridor framings the drop is visibly landing on a lit device rather than on a dark speck.
Relax the label distance-cull for the endpoint that owns the active preset zone, so TC300-02 is chipped in the concessions engineering capture.
